newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares recover from lows, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares recover from lows, seen rising.

text.p: 1740 GMT - Portuguese shares recovered from the lows but still closed slightly down in line with European markets. The most active stocks included Portugal Telecom and Portucel Industrial. Dealers noted some selling by foreign investors of shares in PI and some buying of PT. Foreign investors bought Portugal Telecom shares heavily as they absorbed stock held by employees, small investors and emigrants that was admitted to Lisbon bourse yesterday.

* Telecel continued its upwards march as investors showed confidence in the mobile phone market in Portugal and the company's future performance. Telecel closed at 9,700 escudos, up 170, in volume of 158,990 shares. Earlier, it hit a high of 9,799 escudos.

* Dealers said the market could rise further next week. "Eveything will depend on Wall Street and how it influences the European markets, but I think the positive sentiment will return," a dealer said.
